3
A force of 10 N and a force of 5 N act on an object.
10 N
150°
5 N
object
The angle between the forces is 150.
The resultant force on the object can be resolved into a pair of perpendicular components.
Which row shows numerical expressions for a possible pair of perpendicular components?
force component / N
force component / N
A
10 cos 30 – 5
10 cos 30
B
10 sin 30 – 5
10 cos 30
C
10 – 5 cos 30
5 sin 30
D
10 – 5 sin 30
5 cos 30

hints: Look at the diagram: the $5\text{ N}$ force points left and the $10\text{ N}$ force is $150^\circ$ from it, so the $10\text{ N}$ force is $30^\circ$ from the reversed $5\text{ N}$ line.
Take one axis along the $10\text{ N}$ force, then the $5\text{ N}$ force makes $150^\circ$ with that axis and must be split with $F\cos150^\circ$ and $F\sin150^\circ$.
Use $\cos150^\circ = -\cos30^\circ$ and $\sin150^\circ = \sin30^\circ$ to see which part of the $5\text{ N}$ force opposes the $10\text{ N}$ force and which part is at $90^\circ$ to it.
walkthrough: Choose perpendicular axes with the x-axis along the $10\text{ N}$ force. Then the $10\text{ N}$ force has components $10\text{ N}$ in x and $0$ in y.
The $5\text{ N}$ force is at $150^\circ$ to the x-axis, so its components are $5\cos150^\circ$ in x and $5\sin150^\circ$ in y.
Add x-components for the resultant: $F_x = 10 + 5\cos150^\circ = 10 - 5\cos30^\circ$ in $\text{N}$.
Add y-components for the resultant: $F_y = 0 + 5\sin150^\circ = 5\sin30^\circ$ in $\text{N}$. These $F_x$ and $F_y$ are perpendicular by construction. This is option C.

A.explanation: It incorrectly uses $10\cos30^\circ$ for the 10 N force along its own direction and for the perpendicular direction, instead of $10$ and $0$.

B.explanation: It incorrectly resolves the 10 N force with $\sin30^\circ$ and $\cos30^\circ$ even though the axis is chosen along the 10 N force itself.

C.explanation: Along the 10 N direction the net component is $10 - 5\cos30^\circ$ and perpendicular to it is $5\sin30^\circ$, which correctly resolves the $5$ N force at $150^\circ$.

D.explanation: It swaps $\sin30^\circ$ and $\cos30^\circ$ for the 5 N force, so the parallel opposition $5\cos30^\circ$ and perpendicular part $5\sin30^\circ$ are reversed.
